display.purpose: Titles, wordmark, every numeral on a tile or key.

shadows.name: tile-thickness
shadows.purpose: Raised bone tiles: the side of the tile plus one soft shadow.

shadows.name: tile-pressed
shadows.purpose: Pressed state; face moves down by the thickness.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for UI entering and state changes.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Only the result domino, pips, characters and win title: the playful landing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bone tile that sinks when pressed. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { width: 100%; height: 58px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: oklch(0.965 0.022 88); color: oklch(0.23 0.02 60); font: 700 18px 'Onest Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 oklch(0.67 0.05 74), 0 10px 18px -8px oklch(0.14 0.04 160 / 0.5); transition: transform 110ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 110ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(0.67 0.05 74); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.8 0.125 82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Digit Key
components.css: .ds-key { width: 110px; height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.965 0.022 88); color: oklch(0.23 0.02 60); font: 400 26px 'Bagel Fat One', system-ui; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 oklch(0.67 0.05 74); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 90ms; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(0.67 0.05 74); }

components.name: Submit Key
components.description: Ink tile that sends the guess.
components.css: .ds-submit { width: 100%; height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.23 0.02 60); color: oklch(0.965 0.022 88); font: 400 22px 'Bagel Fat One', system-ui; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 oklch(0.13 0.015 60); } .ds-submit:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(0.13 0.015 60); }

components.name: Code Input Well
components.description: Room code entry sunk into the felt.
components.css: .ds-well { height: 56px; width: 220px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.285 0.066 161); color: oklch(0.975 0.018 95); font: 400 28px 'Bagel Fat One', system-ui; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-align: center; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px oklch(0.1 0.03 160 / 0.45); } .ds-well:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px oklch(0.1 0.03 160 / 0.45), inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.97 0.02 90 / 0.55); }

components.name: Result Domino

narrative.overview: Green felt owns the shell; everything touchable is a raised bone tile that sinks when pressed. Every guess is answered with a domino: fijas as red pips on the left, picas as ink rings on the right.

rules.name: Red means fija
rules.body: Red is reserved for fijas, alerts and destructive actions.

rules.name: Shape before color
rules.body: Fija is a solid dot, pica a ring, nada a dimmed tile.

rules.name: Thickness, not float
rules.body: Depth is the tile's side directly below plus one soft shadow; no glass.

dos: Answer every guess with the domino
Keep bone for touchables and felt for ground
Spend motion on the result moment
donts: No light theme, glass, gradient text or grain
